Gregarious birds pair, in order probably to prevent

PART, a portion of fome whole, confidered as divi¬

Logical PART, is a divifion for which we are indebt¬

Aliquot PART, is a quantity which, being repeated
any number of times, becomes equal to an integer.
Thus 6 is an aliquot part of 24, and 5 an aliquot part

Aliquant PART, is a quantity, which, being repeated
any number of times, becomes always either greater or
lefs than the whole. Thus 5 is an aliquant part of 17,
and 9 an aliquant part of 10, &c.
The aliquant part is refolvable into aliquot parts.
Thus 15, an aliquant part of 20, is refolvable into 10,
a half, and 5 a fourth part of the fame.
